digest.component_or_area: _store/push.py, ticket store event-append path, tracker maintenance
propositions: rebar must not use git stash push/pop/drop in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all worktrees of a repository and a stash created in one worktree can be popped into another
a stash-based merge recovery in push.py left the index with unmerged entries and no MERGE_HEAD, stranding the store and blocking all ticket writes until manual intervention
git stash create followed by stash apply <sha> (instead of push/pop) scopes the stash to a specific commit object by SHA, preventing another worktree's stash from being applied
a stranded index with unmerged paths that are not tracked on the tickets branch and not ticket-shaped must be auto-healed by discarding them, rather than refusing all writes
a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist that backs up the current HEAD before any write, refuses when unpushed ticket commits exist, and maintains a durable audit record
operators must use the maintenance entrypoint or an explicit break-glass override to mutate the tracker; ad-hoc raw git commands (add/commit/merge/push/rm) in the tracker worktree are prohibited
